The team played its home games at the McCarthey Athletic Center, which has a capacity of 6,000. The Bulldogs (also informally referred to as the Zags) were in their 34th season as a member of the [[West Coast Conference]], and were led by head coach [[Mark Few]], who is in his 15th season as head coach. They finished the season 29–7, 15–3 in WCC play to be WCC regular season champions. They were also champions of the [[2014 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] to earn an automatic bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]].
